    "The Alexa devices, streaming sticks and camera do not solve a connection or accessory need I currently have, so none felt worth choosing.",

    "My interest in computer accessories seems to have been stretched into an interest in smart home and entertainment devices.",

  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases usually address specific practical needs, such as adding USB ports or connecting a computer to Ethernet; that purpose matters more than simply being an electronic device.",
    "Connector type, device compatibility and an actual need matter before I would choose another adapter or cable.",
    "My interactions are infrequent and spread over years, so an old purchase is a weak reason to assume I need related equipment today."
  ],
